chunks: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha' narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from the executor of 'Ali ibn al-Sari, who said:

I said to Abū al-Hasan عليه السلام: 'Indeed, 'Ali ibn al-Sari has died and appointed me as his executor.' So he said: 'May Allah have mercy on him.' I said: 'And indeed his son Ja'far committed an act with an umm walad belonging to him, so he ordered me to exclude him from the inheritance.' He said to me: 'Exclude him, if you are truthful, for an affliction will strike him.'

He said: So I returned, and he brought me before Abū Yūsuf the judge. He said to him, 'May Allah rectify you, I am Ja'far ibn 'Ali ibn al-Sari, and this is my father's executor, so order him to hand over to me my inheritance from my father.' He said to me, 'What do you say?' So I said, 'Yes, this is Ja'far ibn 'Ali ibn al-Sari, and I am the executor of 'Ali ibn al-Sari.' He said, 'Then hand over his wealth to him.' I said to him, 'I wish to speak to you.' He said, 'Come near me.' So I came near, where no one could hear my speech, and I said to him, 'This one committed an act with his father's umm walad, so his father ordered me and enjoined upon me that I exclude him from the inheritance and not let him inherit anything.' Then I came to Mūsā ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام in al-Madinah, informed him, and asked him; so he ordered me to exclude him from the inheritance and not let him inherit anything. Then he said, 'By Allah, Abū al-Hasan ordered you?' I said, 'Yes.' Then he made me swear three times, then said to me, 'Carry out what he ordered you; the word is his word.'
The executor said: Then affliction struck him after that. Abū Muhammad al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha' said: I saw him after that.

key_terms.أُمِّ وَلَدٍ: a slave-concubine who bore a child for her master
key_terms.وَصِيِّ: executor of a deceased person's will
key_terms.ٱسْتَحْلَفَنِي: he required me to swear an oath
key_terms.ٱلْقَاضِي: the judge overseeing a legal dispute

ai.seo_question: Can a son be excluded from inheritance for committing an act with his father's umm walad according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a legal dispute concerning inheritance after a son committed an act with his father's umm walad. The executor sought the ruling of Imam Mūsā ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام, who instructed that the son be excluded from the inheritance, and the account concludes that the foretold affliction later befell him.
